message.content:
**Image 1 (mid-combat):** Readability is solid — the cyan-glowing player, white enemies with red eyes, and pink-bladed enemy weapon all separate cleanly against the dark red/teal cityscape, and the UI (HP/EN bars, wave/hostiles/kills counter, ability prompt) is legible without clutter. No broken limbs or z-order issues visible; the floor reflections and rain are subtle and correctly layered behind combatants. If anything, the two enemies on the left slightly overlap and read as one figure at a glance, and the enemy blade tip near the player's leg could use a touch more contrast. Action-wise it's decent — the katana thrust with the ring/hit-circle reads well, but the pose is fairly static; a lean, motion trail, or impact flash would sell the strike harder.

**Image 2 (ability fired):** Big improvement in dynamism — the Blade Storm arc swing, "EXECUTE" text, damage number, hit-count D-rank counter (3 HITS), and +3 pickup all make the moment feel punchy and rewarding. Figures remain readable thanks to the cyan glow and white enemy, though this frame is busier and the enemy being hit partially merges with the player's silhouette. The "E— EXECUTE" label looks like it may be rendering a strikethrough/fragment artifact on the "E" — worth checking whether that's an intentional telegraph or a text glitch. Also the overlapping damage number "18" sits close to the text and slightly clutters. No broken joints or z-order bugs; the screen tint, ghosting effect, and reflection layer all behave. Overall: ship-worthy QA state, with only the EXECUTE text artifact and left-side enemy overlap as minor fix-before-launch items.
